title: Anne of Green Gables
author: L. M. Montgomery
short_summary: Anne Shirley is an imaginative, red-haired orphan mistakenly sent to elderly siblings Matthew and Marilla Cuthbert, who had actually asked for a boy to help on their farm at Green Gables. Anne's talkative, dreamy nature quickly wins the Cuthberts over, and she grows up in the village of Avonlea on Prince Edward Island, making a best friend in Diana Barry and clashing, then eventually becoming close, with a classmate named Gilbert Blythe. Along the way Anne stumbles through mishaps and triumphs at school as she finds her place in her new home.
extended_summary:
When Matthew and Marilla Cuthbert decide to adopt an orphan boy to help around their farm at Green Gables, they are startled to find that the orphanage sent them a talkative, fiercely imaginative girl named Anne Shirley instead. Though Marilla first wants to send Anne back, Matthew quietly insists on keeping her, and Anne's big heart and endless chatter soon win both Cuthberts over. Anne throws herself into life in the small town of Avonlea on Prince Edward Island, forming a devoted friendship with Diana Barry, getting into scrapes like dyeing her hair green by accident, and famously breaking a slate over the head of classmate Gilbert Blythe after he teases her about her red hair.

As the years pass, Anne grows from an awkward, sensitive child into a hardworking, talented young woman, excelling in school and eventually earning a scholarship to college. Her early rivalry with Gilbert slowly softens into mutual respect and warmth. But when Matthew dies and Marilla's eyesight begins to fail, Anne makes the selfless choice to give up her scholarship, staying home at Green Gables to help the aunt and uncle who once took her in — choosing the people and place she has come to love over the wider world waiting for her.
